title: HTTP2: improve window size state tracking
description:
adjust_window_size previously stored the last connection and stream window sizes in the packet's proto data in order to handle multiple dissection passes. This scheme broke down when multiple HTTP2 frames affecting control flow windows appeared in a packet leading to incorrect calculated window sizes.

Use an approach similar to the stateful header frame dissector; keep a list of all control flow state changes in the packet.
